text:
WS::enabled
Description
WS::enabled This can be used to determine whether the Websocket
processing is enabled or disabled for a particular connection.
WS::enabled false This can be used to disable the Websocket processing
for a particular connection.
Syntax
WS::enabled ( 'false' )?
WS::enabled ( ‘false’ )?
Return Value
WS::enabled command returns TRUE if Websocket processing is enabled
for a particular connection, FALSE otherwise.
Valid During
WS_REQUEST WS_RESPONSE HTTP_REQUEST HTTP_RESPONSE
Examples
when
WS_REQUEST
{
WS
::
enabled
false
log
local0.
"Websocket state: [WS::enabled]"
}
when
WS_RESPONSE
{
WS
::
enabled
false
log
local0.
"Websocket state: [WS::enabled]"
}
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
WS
::
enabled
false
}
